subject: QBR prep: pipeline + OKR handoff
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR prep: pipeline + OKR handoff

Team —

As discussed in last week's leadership sync, we need a compact, presentation-ready set of materials for next Friday's QBR exec review. Goal: surface top 25 deals (by ARR and risk), consolidate the forecast, and produce account-by-account one-pagers focused on runway, blockers, and recommended play.

I'm attaching a working workbook (QBR_pipeline_master.xlsx) with three tabs: raw pipeline, forecast by owner, and the exec slide checklist. Please do the following by EOD Monday (48 hours):

- Owners confirm forecast numbers in the "forecast by owner" tab (highlight any changes in yellow).
- Submit a one-page PDF for your accounts to the Drive folder (see link below). One-pagers should include: current ARR, close date and probability, primary blocker, next 3 actions, and any compliance/security flags.
- Flag any deals you want elevated to the exec readout (label with DEAL- tag in the workbook).

Naomi: can you take mid-market and up-level the consolidated numbers?
Markus: can you validate the strategic deals and prepare a 3-slide deep-dive for the board appendix?
Karthik: stitch the one-pagers into a single packet and run a light QA pass.
Aditya: I'll need your read on any asks for pricing/credit ahead of the review.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2BqQBR_pipeline_folder
Attached: QBR_pipeline_master.xlsx

We have a 30-minute dry run on Thursday 8/8 at 10am PT. I'll invite execs to watch the final 12-minute run and leave the remainder for breakout Qs.

Thanks — keep it concise, this is about surfacing risk and clear asks.

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Head of Sales Strategy | Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Aug 2028 11:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR prep: pipeline + OKR handoff

Thanks Tessa — quick read and a few clarifications:

- I'll own the strategic deck appendix. Will prepare 3 slides per strategic account (context, risk, ask). Target upload: Wednesday EOD.
- For the "top 25" selection, can we use ARR * probability threshold (>= $50k ARR and combined weighted > $20k) as the quick filter? If so, I can drop the list into the workbook.
- I see a few pricing exceptions that may need Aditya's approval; I flagged them in the pricing tab of the attached workbook.

Also suggest we add a short "compliance impact" column for any account with private deployment or required audit artifacts — helps avoid last-minute escalations. Naomi, can you add that column when you do the mid-market rollup?

Attachment: QBR_pipeline_master.xlsx (updated pricing flags)

2) Mon morning: Naomi to upload mid-market rollup (midmarket_rollup.csv) and add compliance column.
3) Mon EOD: All owners upload one-pagers. I'll stitch them into the packet and run a QA pass Tue morning.
4) Wed: Markus uploads strategic appendix slides.
5) Thu 10am: Dry run.

Action owners (quick):
- Naomi: mid-market + compliance column + run totals
- Markus: strategic slides (appendix)
- Aditya: pricing exceptions flagged, escalate any credit asks by Monday noon
- Tessa: final exec narrative + deck framing

I'll also normalize close dates (use mm/dd format) and add a confidence band column so we can show 3 scenarios (base / upside / downside).

- Compliance flags: Orbit Analytics requires SOC2 + IP indemnity language. I'm looping Sam (cc'd) for a quick confirmation on the deadline for their audit artifacts.

Great progress — thank you. Quick status update for leadership:

- One-pagers: 21/25 uploaded (Naomi + owners) — good coverage. Outstanding: Cumulus Systems (procurement loop) and BlueCloud — Markus, please prioritize those two for strategic appendix.
- Forecast clean: base/upswing/downside ready; Karthik to finalize scenario slide Monday morning.
- Pricing exceptions: Aditya, I see two requests pending approval (listed in the workbook). Please confirm by Monday noon so we can surface during the dry run.
- Compliance: Sam confirmed (separate email) that Orbit needs SOC2 in advance; legal is already coordinating. Marked in the workbook.

Dry run remains Thursday 8/8 10:00am PT — calendar invite incoming. I'll send the exec-facing deck by Wednesday 6pm so folks have time to review. If anyone anticipates missing the dry run, let me know and we'll coordinate a short catch-up.

Final ask: make sure any changes after Wednesday 6pm are clearly highlighted in yellow in the workbook. We want clean, explainable deltas for the execs.

Thanks — see you Thursday.

—Tessa
